params.body:
Since the reading left the trend page, the headline column held only the headline and the seen line. Everything else sat in the left column: the momentum record and "When the signals landed" ran down below the tags and counts, with the right two thirds of the block empty.

## What changes (`resources/views/pages/trend-detail.blade.php`)

- The two diagrams now sit under the headline and the seen line, side by side from `sm` up:
  - the record, month by month (`x-record`, 300 by 72);
  - when the signals landed (`x-sparkline`, 300 by 72, with its axis and legend).
- On a phone they stack under the headline. The SVGs shrink to the column (`max-w-full`, `h-auto`).
- The left column keeps the tags, the need, momentum, the counted evidence line and the kinds line.

## Tests

- `php artisan test`: 596 of 597. The one failure is `BuildStampTest`, which only fails in a git worktree.
- Looked at in a browser at 1280 px and 390 px.
params.title: Trend page: diagrams beside the headline
